findings.reason: it adds one clause to §2's done-when (point the cache roots at the temporary directory, as §1 already specifies) and without it the node delivers a test that writes outside its own tree, which the repository's test-isolation rule forbids.
findings.text: §2's test builds a temporary repository and records the git runner's argv, but unlike §1's test it never points `RECKON_VELOCITY_CACHE` into that directory, while the newly added third case makes the ledger cache load-bearing: the resumed read is answered from `_ledger_cache_path`, which resolves through `velocity_cache_root()` (`reckon/velocity.py:627`) to `RECKON_VELOCITY_CACHE` or the operator's real cache home, so a worker implementing the case as written leaves a cache file outside the repository under test

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `reckon/velocity.py:1217` is the `git log … -G` search, `:149` is `run_git` with `timeout=180`, `:2149` is `promotion_clock_sources`, `e080ed967` is the 2026-09-25 commit that first adds a per-run record file, and the blocked target `the-ledger-is-one-file-per-run#s4` exists.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §2's test-case list mounts no cache-root isolation, so the third case's resumed read can be answered from the operator's real cache directory.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the defect evidence is committed to `~/.cache/reckon-velocity-window-check/` (three readable logs), not a session scratchpad or node-local `/tmp`, and §2's own slice size AND measured worst slice time are required in the manifest.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new clock-source value `first_primary_record_file_addition_upper_bound` and the new test filename `tests/test_velocity_places_a_run_by_its_record_file.py` name the mechanism; no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag reaches code.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated root cause matches the cited evidence (the traceback names the unsliced `-p -G` patch search), the slice-and-record-file mechanism can produce the done-when, and `recover_ledger_clocks` is reached by the velocity command at `reckon/velocity.py:2537` and `:2958`.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §2 carries one goal ("a long window's ledger search stays inside its git bound"); sliced search and record-file placement are two mechanisms serving that one measure, not two deliverables.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the plan declares `plan-blocks` to `the-ledger-is-one-file-per-run#s4`, which resolves (that file carries `id="s4"`), §2 is the only implementable section, and followup `f-avwmobl-002` recommends exactly it.
